**Job Summary:** 

The Accounts Receivable \& Payable Executive will be primarily responsible for managing customer billing, collections, and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate and timely recording of receivables. The role involves close coordination with internal departments, customers, and vendors to maintain smooth cash flow operations. While the position covers both receivables and payables, the primary focus will be on Accounts Receivable and Reconciliation.

Job Role and responsibilities:

Accounts Receivable (Primary Focus)

* Generate and process customer invoices in line with agreed billing schedules and terms.

* Ensure all entries are properly supported with documentation and comply with accounting standards.
* Maintain a clean and accurate reconciliation tracker for audit and reporting purposes. **Assist in process improvement initiatives for automation and efficiency in reconciliation activities. Accounts Payable (Secondary Focus)**
* Process vendor invoices and ensure accurate recording in the accounting system. **Perform vendor reconciliations and resolve mismatches or pending balances.**  Coordinate with procurement and operations for timely invoice approvals and payment processing. **Support payment runs and ensure compliance with company policies and timelines.**
* **Skills \& Qualifications : Bachelor’s degree in Commerce / Finance / Accounting.**

2–4 years of experience in Accounts Receivable / Reconciliation roles.

**Exposure to both AR \& AP cycles, with emphasis on reconciliation and collection management** 

Strong knowledge of accounting principles and reconciliation processes. **Hands\-on experience with ERP/accounting software (SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar).** 

Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. **Good communication and stakeholder management skills.**

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

description:
**Job: Portfolio Business Manager**


**About Us**


*"Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by* *Avtar \& Seramount**. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.*

***WHY JOIN CAPCO?***



You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.


***MAKE AN IMPACT***



Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.


***\#BEYOURSELFATWORK***



Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.


***CAREER ADVANCEMENT***


*With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.*


***DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION***


*We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.*


**Business Manager: Job Description**



The Business Manager is the engine that turns the business's commercial ambition into action, orchestrating teams across Capco's global organization to align resources, remove barriers and deliver at pace.



This is a senior business leadership role, requiring an executive mindset and the experience, judgement and credibility to operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate complexity, challenge constructively and influence outcomes across teams and geographies, often with limited direct authority.


**Role purpose**



The Business Manager is responsible for ensuring their area of the business \[global client account, capability, or alternative] operates effectively and delivers against its commercial, operational and people objectives.



Working as a trusted partner to the relevant Partner(s), they connect client and sales teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.



The Business Manager brings together the right stakeholders, information and decisions at the right time, resolving dependencies, creating accountability and maintaining momentum across a highly collaborative environment.


**Key responsibilities**


* **Stakeholder management \& business orchestration:** Build and actively manage relationships across client and account teams, regional and global leadership, operations and enterprise functions. Navigate competing perspectives and use influence to align stakeholders around shared priorities, remove barriers and drive collective ownership for delivery.
* **Business performance:** Own the management rhythm for the business area, bringing together commercial, financial, operational, resourcing and people information to provide a clear view of performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive action.
* **Planning \& forecasting:** Lead integrated planning and forecasting across sales, demand, supply, recruitment and financial performance, ensuring assumptions and priorities are aligned across teams.
* **Strategy execution:** Translate global priorities into practical plans, mobilize the relevant teams and maintain momentum and accountability through delivery.
* **Commercial \& client alignment:** Work closely with account and sales teams to understand pipeline, client demand and growth priorities, ensuring these translate into operational and workforce plans.
* **Resourcing \& recruitment:** Connect client demand with workforce supply, skills and recruitment to ensure the business has the right capability and capacity at the right time.
* **Financial management:** Drive financial discipline across the business area, supporting budget management, margin improvement, investment decisions and management of financial risks.
* **People \& talent:** Drive workforce and talent planning, including capacity, attrition, development priorities and succession, working closely with business and people leaders.
* **Business improvement \& operational excellence:** Use data and insight to challenge the status quo, identify opportunities to improve performance and mobilize stakeholders to deliver change. Champion and inform the development of Capco's operational processes and tooling to support broader organizational adoption.


**What success looks like**



A successful Business Manager creates a business that feels joined up rather than siloed, with clear priorities, strong accountability and effective execution.



They ensure that sales ambition, client demand, workforce capacity, financial plans and operational execution are connected, even where delivery requires multiple teams, functions or regions to work together.



Business leaders have a clear view of performance, priorities and emerging risks; stakeholders understand their accountabilities and dependencies; regional and global teams work effectively towards shared goals; and decisions translate into action and measurable outcomes.



Success will be measured against a defined set of KPIs agreed with the relevant business leaders, reflecting the commercial, operational and people priorities of the business area.


***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

title: Senior Executive – Accounts Receivable (AR)
description:
The individual will be responsible for proactively managing overdue receivables, reducing ageing, improving collection effectiveness and ensuring timely resolution of customer account discrepancies.



The position requires **hands\-on working knowledge of SAP**, particularly in relation to customer accounts, open item management, payment allocation, account reconciliation, reporting and AR closing activities.



The Senior Executive will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders including Sales, Customer Service, Credit, Treasury and Finance teams to ensure timely collection of receivables, accurate cash application, resolution of disputes and smooth month\-end closing.



The role requires a high level of ownership, communication skills, analytical ability and a strong collection mindset. The successful candidate should be comfortable handling customer conversations, including difficult collection discussions and payment negotiations, independently driving issues through to resolution.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  


* Manage end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable and Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) activities for assigned customer accounts.
* Monitor AR ageing and proactively follow up on overdue and long\-outstanding receivables.
* Make regular calls and send emails to customers for payment follow\-up, obtain payment commitments and track payments until closure.
* Handle collection conversations professionally and manage difficult payment\-related discussions where required.
* Prioritize high\-value, overdue and high\-risk customer accounts and escalate collection risks appropriately.
* Perform customer account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies related to invoices, payments, credit notes, deductions and open items.
* Perform cash application and payment allocation and resolve unapplied, unallocated and unidentified customer payments.
* Follow up and resolve customer disputes, deductions, short payments and billing\-related queries in coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute Statements of Account and follow up on customer discrepancies.
* Monitor customer payment behaviour, overdue balances and support DSO improvement and collection targets.
* Support bad debt provision, doubtful debt and write\-off activities.
* Perform assigned month\-end and quarter\-end AR closing activities, including reconciliation, open item review, ageing validation and unapplied cash review.
* Perform Intercompany AR/AP reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences.
* Manage the AR/customer mailbox and ensure timely response and resolution of customer and internal queries.
* Use SAP for customer account management, open item review, payment allocation, reconciliation and AR reporting.
* Prepare AR ageing, collection, DSO and other management reports.
* Maintain documentation of customer communications, collection actions, payment commitments, disputes and escalations.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives.
* Support SOP documentation, cross\-training and backup arrangements within the team.

  


**Candidate Requirements**

  


**Education \& Experience**


* Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable / Collections / O2C.
* Experience in a Shared Services Centre (SSC), Global Business Services or multinational environment is preferred.

  


**Must\-Have Technical Skills**


* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end AR/O2C processes.
* Hands\-on experience in customer collections and direct customer calling for overdue payments.
* Ability to obtain and follow up on payment commitments.
* Strong knowledge of AR ageing, overdue debt management and DSO.
* Experience in customer account reconciliation and Intercompany reconciliation.
* Experience in cash application, payment allocation and resolution of unapplied payments.
* Knowledge of customer disputes, deductions, short payments and billing queries.
* Experience in month\-end/quarter\-end AR closing activities.
* Understanding of bad debt provision and write\-off processes.
* Hands\-on SAP/ERP knowledge is mandatory; SAP FI experience is preferred.
* Strong MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS and data analysis.

  


**COMMUNICATION \& BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS**


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Confidence in communicating and negotiating with customers over calls and emails.
* Strong collection mindset with proactive and persistent follow\-up.
* Ability to independently manage assigned customer accounts and drive issues to closure.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and ownership.
* Ability to prioritize workload and meet strict deadlines.
* Good stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Self\-organized, reliable, adaptable and team oriented.
* German language knowledge is an advantage but not mandatory.

  


**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**


* Experience supporting EMEA or international customers/entities.
* Shared Services / Global Finance SSC experience.
* SAP FI – Accounts Receivable experience.
* Experience with Power BI and AR reporting dashboards.
* Experience in process improvement, automation or finance transformation initiatives.

  


**KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**


* Timely collection and reduction of overdue receivables.
* Improvement in AR ageing and DSO.
* Timely completion of customer calls and collection follow\-ups.
* Accurate customer account reconciliation and cash application.
* Timely resolution of unapplied cash, disputes and deductions.
* Timely completion of month\-end and quarter\-end activities.
* Accurate and timely AR reporting.
* Compliance with agreed SLAs and company policies.

title: Business Development Manager – Strategic Business Customers (SBC)
description:
**ABOUT MARKETING \& SALES DEPARTMENT**


The Marketing \& Sales division at DHL Global Forwarding serves as a crucial link between clients and various operational and product departments. Its primary objectives include acquiring new business opportunities while also ensuring the retention of existing clientele.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


The BDM of SBC Development, responsible for project management, including identifying and developing SBC accounts. Conducts in\-depth research to build future SBC accounts and drives pre\-selling activities such as internal mapping of current engagement levels and supply chain decision\-making. Aligns with internal stakeholders, including SMT, to build value propositions and win strategies. Ensures target trading and account onboarding to initiate required engagement across levels and manages account transitions for trading accounts. Identifies new projects to target potential business opportunities.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Operational Excellence**


* Conduct in\-depth analysis of existing data to identify high potential opportunities.
* Scope all possible business opportunities and complete profiling activities.
* Connect with network teams and key stakeholders for complete mapping, including supply chain, key decision\-makers, and overall processes.

  

**Strategic Planning and Execution**


* Engage with multiple stakeholders to design customer\-centric solutions.
* Develop a win plan to onboard identified accounts, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy.
* Analyse RFQs and map high priority SBC target lists to identify and capitalize on key opportunities.

  

**Implementation and Coordination**


* Work closely with the SMT on the onboarding process for new accounts, ensuring alignment and active engagement.
* Coordinate with products, network, stations, and regional teams to develop and implement tailored solutions for clients.

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the global forwarding industry, DGF products (AFR/OFR), and business models, with experience in customer relations and trade lanes.
* Building Sales Pipeline: Efficiently managing the sales pipeline from lead generation to closure, ensuring timely follow\-ups and conversions.
* Strategic Planning and Execution: Developing and implementing strategic plans to drive Key Account channel growth aligned with organizational goals.
* Customer Relationship Management: Understanding customer needs, preferences, and pain points to tailor solutions and drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.

  

**Behavioural Competencies**


* Innovation: Capacity to think innovatively and propose creative solutions to address challenges and seize business opportunities.
* Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends, sales techniques, and best practices.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

  

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* Bachelor's degree is required.
* Proficiency in virtual teamwork, maintaining a motivated team, and addressing individual needs, both internally and externally.
* Strong networking skills across diverse cultures and organizational levels, coupled with conceptual thinking and analytical capabilities.
* 8\-10 years of sales management experience, customer\-focused orientation, and knowledge of key trading countries and commodities, enhancing demand and lead generation abilities.
* Strong customer orientation coupled with a high level of empathy.

**Preferred**


* Post\-graduate degree with a focus on sales/marketing.
* Experience of working at a multinational freight forwarding company.

title: Sr Adv Appl/Sys Sales Engineer
description:
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.

* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.

  
**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**

* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.


\#LI\-RK1

Well versed with what it takes to win consulting work, allowing you to build trust and effectively partner with the managing directors that lead the sales pursuits. Prepare for and support conversations with potential clients.

Define proposal response requirements and best sales messaging approach.
  
  

Bring the latest knowledge and best of content to each opportunity (e.g., industry trends benchmarking, competitive insights, etc.)

Prepare and help lead orals with innovating ways of selling to help differentiate Accenture.
  
  

Leverage Claude, Enterprise ChatGPT, and other AI and Agentic AI capabilities Accenture offers in your day\-to\-day work.
  
  

Content Management / Continuous Improvement
  
  

Develop go\-to\-market approach / assets.
  
  

Maintain global repository of sales assets (e.g., proposals, stage 0 decks credentials, etc.)
  
  

Conduct reviews (loss / delivery) with client teams to understand how we can improve and harvest deliverables.
  
  

Stay relevant through training, research, client interaction and feedback sessions.

Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering
  
  

10\+ years functional experience in the Digital Core space
  
  

A minimum of 5 years in sales or consulting at Accenture
  
  

English language fluency (oral and written)

Experience in Sales and Business Development

title: Business Development Manager, Monetization
description:
Meta is seeking a Business Development Manager to drive monetization strategy and partnership development in the key India market. In this role, you will define and execute high\-impact commercial frameworks that expand Meta's revenue ecosystem across advertising, commerce, and emerging monetization surfaces. You will identify, structure, and close transformative partnerships that unlock new revenue streams, shape product monetization strategy, and influence how Meta's platforms generate sustainable value at scale. This is a role for a experienced business development leader who can operate with full autonomy across complex, ambiguous deal environments and drive company\-level outcomes.  

  

  

### **Business Development Manager, Monetization Responsibilities:**

* Define and lead the long\-term monetization partnership strategy across Meta's advertising, commerce, and platform revenue surfaces
* Identify, evaluate, and execute high\-value strategic partnerships that unlock new monetization opportunities or expand existing revenue streams
* Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including revenue\-sharing arrangements, API monetization deals, and platform licensing frameworks
* Collaborate with product, engineering, legal, and finance teams to align partnership structures with Meta's monetization product roadmap
* Develop and own executive\-level business cases and investment theses for new monetization initiatives, presenting to senior leadership
* Establish frameworks for evaluating partnership ROI, deal economics, and long\-term revenue impact across Meta's monetization portfolio
* Serve as the primary external relationship owner for strategic monetization partners, managing C\-suite and senior stakeholder engagement
* Anticipate market shifts in digital advertising, commerce, and platform monetization to proactively shape Meta's partnership positioning
* Provide strategic guidance to cross\-functional teams on monetization deal structures, market dynamics, and competitive landscape
* Drive organizational alignment on monetization partnership priorities, influencing roadmap decisions and resource allocation across business units

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12\+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development with a focus on monetization, advertising, or platform revenue
* Experience structuring and closing complex, multi\-party commercial agreements including revenue\-sharing, licensing, or platform monetization deals
* Track record of defining and executing partnership strategies that have generated measurable, large\-scale revenue impact
* Experience engaging and influencing C\-suite and senior executive stakeholders at partner organizations
* Experience operating independently in ambiguous, high\-stakes deal environments with accountability for company\-level outcomes

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience building and scaling business development functions or establishing new partnership categories from the ground up
* Background in commerce, payments, or emerging platform monetization surfaces such as messaging, AI\-driven experiences, or wearables
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in digital advertising ecosystem partnerships, including programmatic, performance marketing, or ad tech monetization models
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex deal structures into clear financial models and executive\-ready strategic narratives
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. title: Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------


We are seeking a Secure by Supplier Cyber Security Consultant to help embed secure\-by\-design principles into supplier engagements from the earliest stages of the supplier lifecycle. This role focuses on identifying, assessing and mitigating cyber security and regulatory risks associated with third\-party suppliers, while ensuring compliance with UK Telecom Security Regulations and Vodafone’s internal security standards.
The successful candidate will work closely with business, technology and supplier stakeholders to evaluate supplier security postures, provide risk\-based security recommendations, influence sourcing decisions, and support the inclusion of appropriate contractual controls. This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting Vodafone’s supply chain while enabling secure and compliant business operations.**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Perform technical assessments of supplier security capabilities and regulatory compliance during supplier sourcing and contracting activities.
* Evaluate security and compliance risks using a standardised assessment methodology and identify effective mitigation measures.
* Provide security recommendations to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions.
* Engage with external suppliers to understand, validate and influence their security and regulatory compliance positions.
* Collaborate with internal subject matter experts and stakeholders to verify supplier security positions and support effective decision\-making.
* Act as the technical security specialist when communicating cyber security risks to business, technology and supplier stakeholders.
* Support supplier contract negotiations by identifying technical security requirements and recommending contractual controls to minimise risk.
* Develop, maintain and improve relevant processes, reporting and assessment tools.
* Provide guidance on cyber security and compliance\-related matters to internal colleagues and suppliers.
* Promote security as a business enabler and support the adoption of secure\-by\-design principles across supplier engagements.
* Ensure suppliers understand and adhere to Vodafone’s security standards and regulatory obligations.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experience working in a pre\-sales, sourcing, risk assessment or supplier security environment, evaluating responses and determining security recommendations.
* Strong ability to communicate security requirements, risks and mitigation measures to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, traffic flows, network architecture and security best practices.
* Experience managing and influencing stakeholders across different levels of an organisation.
* Significant professional experience in information technology and cyber security, ideally within supplier risk, security assurance or governance roles.
* Knowledge of cloud security, web services security, container security, connectivity, identity and access management, network security and penetration testing concepts.
* Understanding of security governance across Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) environments.
* Expertise across telecommunications technologies including:
	+ Switching and routing technologies
	+ Routers, modems and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs)
	+ Radio Access Networks (RAN)
	+ Core routers, firewalls and border gateways
	+ Mobile devices, tablets and IoT environments
	+ Mobile Private Networks (MPN) using 4G/5G technologies
* University degree in Information Security or an equivalent discipline.
* One or more recognised industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, GIAC, TOGAF, SABSA or equivalent.
* 5\+ years of experience in cyber security.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to influence supplier security decisions across a global telecommunications environment.
* Exposure to complex cyber security, supplier assurance and regulatory compliance challenges.
* Collaboration with business, technology and cyber security specialists across multiple functions.
* Ability to contribute directly to Vodafone’s supply chain security strategy and risk reduction objectives.
* Experience working with evolving telecom security regulations and industry\-leading security practices.
* Opportunity to shape secure\-by\-design adoption across supplier ecosystems.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced supplier cyber security assessment and assurance techniques.
* Regulatory compliance evaluation, including UK Telecom Security requirements.
* Security risk quantification, recommendation development and risk mitigation planning.
* Contractual security control evaluation and negotiation support.
* Supplier governance and third\-party risk management practices.
* Stakeholder management and executive\-level security communication.
* Telecom network security across fixed, mobile and emerging technology environments.
* Security governance across cloud, SaaS, PaaS and IaaS delivery models.

----------------------------------------------

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------



At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect
description:
CSQ427R264


At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  

  

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
  

  

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post\-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
  

  

**The impact you will have:**
* Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
* Lead the post\-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
* Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
* Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
* Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
* Create, own and execute a point\-of\-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
* Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
* Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer\-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
	+ Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
	+ Enablement / user growth plan
	+ Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
	+ Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning \& optimization)
	+ Executive and operational governance
* Provide internal and external updates \- KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression \- to your Technical GM

**What we look for:**
* 10\+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
* Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
* Experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
* Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
* Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
* Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
* Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
* Experience conducting open\-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
* Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**


Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  

  

**Benefits**  

  

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.  

  

  



**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**


At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
